rows.text: [NPC] knows the whereabouts of a small asteroid that has some remarkable metal properties. Their contacts would like to examine the metal from the asteroid and are willing to pay highly for the privilege. MINING FOR METAL (SM): [NPC] wants you to mine 1d3 x 10 Metals from zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system and sell at [PORT] the star system's port. Expires: [DATE] (1d3+3 months). If the star system has an asteroid, this is where you must mine and the operation is placed in its zone; otherwise, you must generate a random empty zone in the star system and place the operation there. Please note: By adding the operation to an empty zone in this manner does not add a permanent asteroid to the star system; the asteroid will only be functional to perform the mission and will only exist until the mission has expired or has been completed.

A food processing plant has been hit by a power surge and has shut down. It has been inoperable for months and the shareholders are getting restless. The plant is now quite a dangerous place, and has become overrun with all kinds of creatures, droids, and villainous scum. The owner is looking for someone to head on in and investigate the cause of the power overload to see if it is a viable option to send in engineers to make repairs. POWER OVERLOAD (AM O2 NV): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system [NPC] wants you to Explore until 1d3+6 yellow areas have been added to the map sheet and have been searched. Expires: [DATE] (1d3 months). When the last yellow area has been searched the source of the power surge has been discovered and the owner can get it fixed. If the star system has an agricultural world, this is the zone where the mission is located. If the system doesn’t have an agricultural world then you must generate a random empty zone in the star system and place the operation there. Please note: By adding the operation to an empty zone in this manner does not add a permanent agricultural world to the star system; the agricultural world will only be functional to perform the mission and will only exist until the mission has expired or has been completed.

A water processing plant has been hit by a power surge and has shut down. It has been inoperable for months now and the shareholders are getting restless. The plant is now quite a dangerous place, and has become overrun with all kinds of creatures, droids, and villainous scum. The owner is looking for someone to head on in and investigate the cause of the power overload to see if it is a viable option to send in engineers to make repairs. POWER OVERLOAD (AM O2 NV): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system [NPC] wants you to Explore until 1d3+6 green areas have been added to the map sheet and have been searched. Expires: [DATE] (1d3 months). When the last green area has been searched the source of the power surge has been discovered and the owner can get it fixed. If the star system has a water world, this is the zone where the mission is located. If the system doesn’t have a water world then you must generate a random empty zone in the star system and place the operation there. Please note: By adding the operation to an empty zone in this manner does not add a permanent water world to the star system; the water world will only be functional to perform the mission and will only exist until the mission has expired or has been completed.

A warehouse was closed due to a chemical leak from a container. It has been inoperable for months now and the shareholders are getting restless. The plant is now quite a dangerous place, and has become overrun with all kinds of creatures, droids, and villainous scum. The owner is looking for someone to head on in and purge the scourge that has taken control of the warehouse. PURGE THE SCOURGE (AM O2 NV): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system [NPC] wants you to Explore 1d3+6 red areas and Kill the enemy there (they ignore all escape reaction results). Expires: [DATE] (1d3 months). When the last red area and its enemy has been slain the owner can reopen the facility and the mission is completed. If the star system you generate for the mission's location has a moon, or a dead planet point of interest, then this is the zone where the mission is located. If the system has both a moon and a dead planet, you must generate randomly between them where the mission will be located. If the system has neither a moon, or a dead planet then you must generate a random empty zone where the mission will be located.

to replace the feature with its name (or zone number) found on the sector's Star Systems And Zones Sheet. 5 [NPC] is suspicious of a cover up at a water processing plant. The plant has a lot of contaminated water it is trying to sell off before the authorities find out and takes action. CONTAMINATION (SM): [NPC] wants you to collect 1d3 x 20 Water from zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system and sell at [PORT] the star system's port. Expires: [DATE] (1d3+1 months). If the star system has a water world, this is where you must collect the water from and the operation is placed in its zone; otherwise, you must generate a random empty zone in the star system and place the operation there. Please note: By adding the operation to an empty zone in this manner does not add a permanent water world to the star system; the water world will only be functional to perform the mission and will only exist until the mission has expired or has been completed.

An armoury facility that shut down over twenty years ago is rumoured to have some interesting pieces of armour laying around in various states of repair. You might just pop in the next time you're passing through the system and take a look. THE ARMOURY (AM O2 NV): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system enter the facility and Collect 1d3+1 items from table A - Armour. Expires: N/A.

There is a huge problem with vermin under the space dock. The port is desperate for anyone to enter the service tunnels and terminate them. When proof of the termination is handed over (the scraps) the port's authorities will hand over payment. VERMIN CONTROL (AM NV): At [PORT] in the [SYSTEM] system after a port phase, begin the away mission and Loot 1d6+6 Scraps (25c) from enemies there (Hand In). Expires: [DATE] (1d3 months).

An inventor approached a military grade weapon's facility with a prototype weapon. The weapon was so powerful, if it ever got constructed it would be a planet-killer. However, whilst the plans were en route a galactic peace activist posing as a security guard stole them and hid them inside a security pass. Their intention was to destroy the plans at a later time, away from preying eyes. However, there was a mix up and the security pass with the plans got thrown out and taken to a dump site, where it is now lost. SECURITY BREACH (AM O2): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system [NPC] wants you to enter a dump site and Collect (Hand In) 1 Security Pass with the hidden plans, or 1 Objective Item (see operation for details). Expires: [DATE] (1 month). If the star system you generate for the mission's location has a moon, or a dead planet point of interest, then this is the zone where the mission is located. If the system has both a moon and a dead planet, you must generate randomly between them where the mission will be located. If the system has neither a moon, or a dead planet then you must generate a random empty zone where the mission will be located. Whilst on the away mission if the captain gains a security pass, it may be the pass with the hidden plans, and you roll 1d100 to check; if the result is 30 or less then it's the security pass with the hidden plans and the away mission is completed. Note: If the captain finds a batch of security passes (i.e. the game instructs +2 Pass, or +3 Pass), you do not check each individual pass, but instead make one roll for the entire batch. Alternatively, the first Objective Item the captain finds is in fact the security pass with the hidden plans and the mission is completed.

[NPC] is suspicious of a cover up at a food processing plant. The plant has a lot of contaminated food it is trying to sell off before the authorities find out and takes action. CONTAMINATION (SM): [NPC] wants you to collect 1d3 x 20 Food from zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system and sell at the star system's port). Expires: [DATE] (1d3+1 months). If the star system has an agricultural world, this is where you must collect the food from and the operation is placed in its zone; otherwise, you must generate a random empty zone in the star system and place the operation there. Please note: By adding the operation to an empty zone in this manner does not add a permanent agricultural world to the star system; the agricultural world will only be functional to perform the mission and will only exist until the mission has expired or has been completed.

to replace the feature with its name (or zone number) found on the sector's Star Systems And Zones Sheet. 10 A once thriving space port was abandoned fifty years ago, when a criminal organisation took it over. Overnight, corporations pulled out and moved resources to legally run space ports and after a few months the place was unable to sustain its own costs and was abandoned. A former employee of one corporation has some sensitive information stored on a data bank that was left behind and now after all this time would like it back, so it can be destroyed. DATA RETRIEVAL (AM NV): At the abandoned space port in zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system Collect 1 Objective Item for NPC (Hand In). Expires: [DATE] (1d10+20 days).

A collector of antiquities, has located the whereabouts of a pair of important artefacts they would like to add to their collection. They will meet the captain at a space port near to their residency to take receipt of them and pay the captain. THE COLLECTOR (AM O2 NV): Search an abandoned mine in zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system and Collect 2 Objective Items for NPC. Then head to the space port in the [SYSTEM] system (Hand In). Expires: N/A. If the star system you generate for the mission's location has a moon, or a dead planet point of interest, then this is the zone where the mission is located. If the system has both a moon and a dead planet, you must generate randomly between them where the mission will be located. If the system has neither a moon, or a dead planet then you must generate a random empty zone where the mission will be located. The star system where the two Objective Items are handed in, is where the collector will take receipt of the artefacts and pay the captain for retrieving them. When you generate this star system, it must be a different star system from the one the away mission is located in.

THE WEAPON'S FACTORY (AM O2 NV): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system enter the factory and Collect 1d3+1 items from table W - Weapons. Expires: N/A. A weapon's factory that shut down over twenty years ago, is rumoured to have some interesting weapons just laying around. You might just pop in the next time you're passing through and take a look.

The port's authorities are offering a special bonus to starships trading depleted goods. CARGO SHORTAGE (SM): Sell 1d3 x 50 [CARGO] at [PORT] in the [SYSTEM] system. Expires: [DATE] (1d3+2 months). To determine the [CARGO] that is in short supply roll 1d3: 1 = Water, 2 = Waste, 3 = Bio Waste. Using table (GB) C - Cargo Prices reset the affected cargo's buy and sell values at the port on the economy sheet using the +4$ row. Next, add the number of units of cargo you must sell to the port's zone and deduct from this number each time you sell the affected cargo at the port. When you have sold the required number, the mission is completed and the captain receives the reward. Note: You are not permitted to buy the affected cargo at the port, until the mission has been completed or has expired.

A factory that shut down over twenty years ago, is rumoured to have some interesting items just laying around. You might just pop in the next time you're passing through and take a look. THE FACTORY (AM O2 NV): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system enter the factory and Collect 1d3+1 items from table K - Kit. Expires: N/A.

Starting a new recycling business was going to be hard, but a budding entrepreneur has just bought a disused recycling plant and is looking for a detailed survey, including a comprehensive map of the layout. THE RECYCLING PLANT (AM O2 NV): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system [NPC] wants you to Explore a recycling plant until 1d3 yellow, 1d3 green, 1d3 red, and 1d3 blue areas have been added to the map sheet. Expires: [DATE] (1 month). If the star system you generate for the mission's location has a moon, or a dead planet point of interest, then this is the zone where the mission is located. If the system has both a moon and a dead planet, you must generate randomly between them where the mission will be located. If the system has neither a moon, or a dead planet then you must generate a random empty zone where the mission will be located.

to replace the feature with its name (or zone number) found on the sector's Star Systems And Zones Sheet. 16 The leader of a resistance group is planning a large scale rebellion against the authorities of a star system. The battle plans for their attack are currently being hidden on several security passes in the leader's hideout. Thinking they are safe from a security breach, the rebels have no idea an undercover agent has dispatched a lone infiltrator to enter the hideout and secure the passes for decoding. THE REBELLION (AM NV): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system [NPC] wants you to enter a secret hideout and Explore until 1d3+3 pips have been shaded on the Pass track. Expires: [DATE] (3 months).

[NPC] knows the whereabouts of a small asteroid that has some remarkable mineral properties. Their contacts would like to examine the mineral from the asteroid and are willing to pay highly for the privilege. MINERAL MINING (SM): [NPC] wants you to mine 1d3 x 10 Minerals from zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system and sell at [PORT] the star system's port. Expires: [DATE] (1d3+3 months). If the star system has an asteroid, this is where you must mine and the operation is placed in its zone; otherwise, you must generate a random empty zone in the star system and place the operation there. Please note: By adding the operation to an empty zone in this manner does not add a permanent asteroid to the star system; the asteroid will only be functional to perform the mission and will only exist until the mission has expired or has been completed.

A starship that was attacked by the cyborg years ago, is on the verge of breaking apart. It has been derelict in space for some time now, but has just one month left before it will suffer a huge hull breach and self destruct. The owner has been putting it off for years, but is now looking for someone to go aboard and search for an item of sentimental value. SENTIMENTAL VALUE (AM O2 NV): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system [NPC] wants you to Explore a starship until 1d6+8 areas have been searched. The next item you Collect completes the mission (Hand In). Expires: [DATE] (1 month). For background information on the Cyborgs, see Mission # 95-96, History of the Cyborgs in the main D100 Space rulebook.

Space pirates have been causing problems in a star system for months now and some of the civilians who live in the region have decided to take action. A designated spokesperson from their group has offered a bounty on their heads. SPACE PIRATES (AM NV): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system [NPC] wants you to enter the space pirates secret base and Kill 1d3+3 enemies marked with a (Gun) t. Expires: [DATE] (1d3+3 month). If the star system you generate for the mission's location has a moon, or a dead planet point of interest, then this is the zone where the mission is located. If the system has both a moon and a dead planet, you must generate randomly between them where the mission will be located. If the system has neither a moon, or a dead planet then you must generate a random empty zone where the mission will be located.

An armoury facility that shut down over twenty years ago is rumoured to have some interesting pieces of armour laying around in various states of repair. You might just pop in the next time you're passing through and take a look. THE ARMOURY (AM O2 NV): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system enter the facility and Loot 1d3+2 items from table A - Armour. Expires: N/A.

[NPC] knows the whereabouts of a small gas formation that has some remarkable chemical properties. Their contacts would like to examine the chemical from the gas formation and are willing to pay highly for the privilege. PARTICLE SCOOP (SM): [NPC] wants you to scoop 1d3 x 20 Chemicals from zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system and sell at [PORT] the star system's port. Expires: [DATE] (1d3+3 months). If the star system has a gases point of interest, this is where you must collect the chemicals from and the operation is placed in its zone; otherwise, you must generate a random empty zone in the star system and place the operation there. Please note: By adding the operation to an empty zone in this manner does not add a permanent gases point of interest to the star system; the gases point of interest will only be functional to perform the mission and will only exist until the mission has expired or has been completed.

to replace the feature with its name (or zone number) found on the sector's Star Systems And Zones Sheet. 22 A science lab has been affected by the breakout of a strange, yet vile disease that has caused mutations amongst its staff and the creatures it was experimenting on. The lab has been evacuated, and now its time to deal with the infestation. INFESTATION (AM O2 NV): Search the infested science lab in zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system. You must Loot 1d6+12 Scraps (25c) from enemies there (Hand In). Expires: [DATE] (1 month and 2d10 days). If the star system you generate for the mission's location has a moon, or a dead planet point of interest, then this is the zone where the mission is located. If the system has both a moon and a dead planet, you must generate randomly between them where the mission will be located. If the system has neither a moon, or a dead planet then you must generate a random empty zone where the mission will be located.

A weapon's factory that shut down over twenty years ago, is rumoured to have some interesting weapons just laying around. You might just pop in the next time you're passing through and take a look. THE WEAPON'S FACTORY (AM O2 NV): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system enter the factory and Loot 1d3+2 items from table W - Weapons. Expires: N/A.

A family of space explorers have crash landed on a small moon and have taken up refuge at an abandoned droid factory. A family friend has offered a reward to anyone who can rescue them. However, a malfunction droid at the factory has other ideas. DROID TROUBLE (AM NV): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system [NPC] wants you to Explore until the 2nd Objective Area is found; then you must Kill the Malfunctioning Droid (E42) to rescue the family. Expires: [DATE] (1d6+1 months). If the star system you generate for the mission's location has a moon point of interest, then this is the zone where the mission is located. If the system doesn’t have a moon then you must generate a random zone where the mission will be located (see Random Star Systems and Zones). Malfunctioning Droid s AV: 30 Def: 2 Dmg: -1 HP: 8 [K]: Parts (50c) Abilities: Cybercon™

A private investor has spent a lot of credits to install a satellite grid system in the [SYSTEM] system, but something has come along and damaged them. A reward is now being offered for someone to travel to each zone and repair the satellites and bring the grid back online. SATELLITE REPAIRS (SM): In the [SYSTEM] system [NPC] wants you to repair a satellite in each of its 10 Zones (see operation for details). Expires: [DATE] (1d3 months). When you roll for the NPC's occupation add 40 to the roll. In each star system perform the SATELLITE REPAIR test successfully to repair a satellite. Tick the satellite's zone when it's repaired. When all ten zones have been ticked all of the satellites have been repaired and the grid is back online and the captain receives the reward. SATELLITE REPAIR - Test: Int -30, +/- CM, +/- DT [S: -1 AP, repaired, tick zone] [F: -1d3 AP, -1d3 PL] (Engineers)

A factory that shut down over twenty years ago, is rumoured to have some interesting items just laying around. You might just pop in the next time you're passing through and take a look. THE FACTORY (AM O2 NV): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system enter the factory and Loot 1d3+2 items from table K - Kit. Expires: N/A.

to replace the feature with its name (or zone number) found on the sector's Star Systems And Zones Sheet. 28 A few months ago a starship got itself stuck in a gas plane, which did irreparable damage to its environmental control and caused some areas of the ship to be scorching hot like a desert and others to be humid like a swamp. Unfortunately the crew were killed instantly by an influx of dangerous gases being sucked into the filtration system. A close friend of the ship's captain is now looking for answers to why this happened and is offering a reward for the ship's black box. BLACK BOX (AM O2 NV): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system [NPC] wants you to Explore a starship. When 1d3+4 green and 1d3+4 red areas have been found you've located the bridge and the black box. Expires: [DATE] (1d3 months). If the star system you generate for the mission's location has a gases point of interest, then this is the zone where the mission is located. If the system doesn’t have a gases point of interest then you must generate a random zone where the mission will be located (see Random Star Systems and Zones).

A private war has been raging for over 20 years now; it's between two corporations both competing for the rights to supply a star system with its main energy supply. Hostile action has been taken before; however, this time one side has gone too far and has sent in a crack team of undercover agents and droids to a rivals power plant on a small moon. Their intention is to initiate the plant's self destruct protocols. If the team is successful and the main reactors are blown up, a massive amount of radiation will leak, killing thousands of workers and their families. In an effort to impede the attack, the corporation has evacuated the plant and removed all safety protocols until the infiltration can been dealt with. POWER DOWN (AM O2 NV): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system enter the plant and Kill 1d6+6 enemies on table E marked with a (Gun) t or a (Bot) s. Expires: [DATE] (1 month + 1d10 days). If the star system you generate for the mission's location has a moon point of interest, then this is the zone where the mission is located. If the system doesn’t have a moon point of interest then you must generate a random zone where the mission will be located (see Random Star Systems and Zones).

The port's authorities are offering a special bonus to starships trading depleted goods. CARGO SHORTAGE (SM): Sell 1d3 x 50 [CARGO] at [PORT] in the [SYSTEM] system. Expires: [DATE] (1d3+2 months). To determine the [CARGO] that is in short supply roll 1d3: 1 = Textiles, 2 = Minerals, 3 = Industrial. Using table (GB) C - Cargo Prices reset the affected cargo's buy and sell values at the port on the economy sheet using the +4$ row. Next, add the number of units of cargo you must sell to the port's zone and deduct from this number each time you sell the affected cargo at the port. When you have sold the required number, the mission is completed and the captain receives the reward. Note: You are not permitted to buy the affected cargo at the port, until the mission has been completed or has expired.

In a bygone era a scientist working at a pharmaceutical plant was developing an inoculation for Velorian Fever. In mysterious circumstance the scientist suddenly died and his work was never completed. Just days after his death, government agents stormed the plant and closed it down. It has remained unoccupied ever since. Many believe that somewhere inside the plant, is a med pack that if used will ease the suffering for anyone with Velorian Fever. A few days ago a small child came down with the fever and his family are desperate to find out if the rumours of the med pack are true. VELORIAN FEVER (AM O2 NV): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system [NPC] wants you to enter the pharmaceutical plant and Collect either 1 (M) Med Pack, 1 (L) Med Pack, or 1 (XL) Med Pack (Hand In). Expires: [DATE] (1 month). If the star system you generate for the mission's location has a moon point of interest, then this is the zone where the mission is located. If the system doesn’t have a moon point of interest then you must generate a random zone where the mission will be located (see Random Star Systems and Zones). An outbreak of Velorian Fever has erupted all over the star system. Whether you add or accept this mission or not, add "VELORIAN FEVER VF:10" to the affected star system's hex on the hex sheet. Then, add a trigger arrow g to the current star date and make the following date entry: "[DATE] VELORIAN FEVER : Whenever the captain enters the [SYSTEM] system they may become infected with Velorian Fever, see the Velorian Fever event". Next, shade the star date 1d3+3 months in the future and make the following date entry: "[DATE] Find the date entry for VELORIAN FEVER, and place a line through it; then delete its trigger arrow g from the star date; it no longer applies. Then, remove VELORIAN FEVER from the affected star system on the hex sheet."

to replace the feature with its name (or zone number) found on the sector's Star Systems And Zones Sheet. 32 "Many years ago a fleet of starships attacked my home world. They came in their thousands and dropped millions of troops. They tore through our cities, towns, and villages, taking prisoners and confiscating anything of value. My world was destroyed in hours and my people were killed or became slaves to work in the mines. I was one of the lucky ones and was sent to serve an ambassador on a starship. Just ten weeks after I had witnessed my family being murdered, I managed to escape and when I got far enough away, I realised I had left something behind. It's my most prized possession, and I have always wanted it back. Today I spotted that ship, the ambassador's ship; it's in orbit; and now is the time, I must get it back! Will you help me?" PRIZED POSSESSION (AM O2): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system [NPC] wants you to Explore a starship until 1d6+10 areas have been searched. The next item you Collect completes the mission (Hand In). Expires: [DATE] (1 month).

[NPC] was involved in a head-on collision with another starship in a popular area of space in the [SYSTEM] system. The debris from the incident is causing a danger to starships travelling through and needs clearing up. Unfortunately for [NPC] even though they survived, the accident was their fault and the clean up cost is now their responsibility. DEBRIS FIELD: (SM): [NPC] wants you to clear 1d10 +10 debris from zone [ZONE #] (see operation for details) in the [SYSTEM] system. Expires: [DATE] (1d3 months). Add the number of debris that need clearing to the zone in the star system as you generate the mission's details. Then whenever the captain is in the mission's zone they may perform the CLEAR DEBRIS test. Each time the test is passed successfully 1d3 debris is shot and destroyed and you deduct the number from the number of debris in the zone. When the number of debris is reduced to 0, all the debris is destroyed and the captain receives the reward. CLEAR DEBRIS - Test: Dex -20, +/- CM, +/- DT [S: -1 AP, -1d3 Debris] [F: -1d3 AP, -1d3 PL] (Pilots)

An abandoned mine on a small asteroid has just been sold and the new owner wants a detailed map of the complex. MAPPING MISSION (AM O2 NV): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system [NPC] wants you to enter a mine and Explore until 1d3+3 yellow, 1d3+2 red, and 1d3+1 green areas have been added to the map sheet. Expires: [DATE] (1d3 months).

A holodeck, used for training has malfunctioned and its program will not shut down. To make matters worse, its safety features have been set to off. All personnel that have been sent in to reach the kill switch have so far been killed by the holodeck program, and the port is now looking for volunteers. HOLODECK (AM O2 NV): At [PORT] in the [SYSTEM] system, after a port phase, begin mission and Explore until 1d3+4 areas are searched. Then on subsequent searches roll 1d10. On a 1 the kill switch is found and mission is completed. Expires: [DATE] (1d3 months).

"I was aboard a transporter ship when the ion storm pulled us in. We were the first to make it to an escape pod before the ship hit a large asteroid. Many died in the crash. The ship is now wedged in the side of the floating rock and on board is our travel chest. It has something inside we must have back. Will you help us?" TRAVEL CHEST (AM NV): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system [NPC] wants you to board the crashed ship and Collect any item (Hand In) found in a chest (see operation for details). Expires: [DATE] (1d3+2 months). If the star system you generate for the mission's location has an asteroid point of interest, then this is the zone where the mission is located. If the system doesn’t have an asteroid point of interest then you must generate a random zone where the mission will be located (see Random Star Systems and Zones). The travel chest the captain needs to open is actually one of the chests generated by geographic areas (i.e. results 19-22, 26-29, 42, 43, 45-48, 55-58, 78, 80, 91-92, and 93-95). Until the captain locates a chest (i.e. rolls one of those results), they may roll on table G each time they search an area. The roll is made after the search results have been completed and any triggered time effects have been dealt with. The area does not need to be green and can be of any colour. When searching, all results that do not have a type of chest are ignored. As soon as a chest is discovered the captain may no longer make this additional check when searching. If the captain discovers more than one chest, the first that is opened, is the one with the item and the mission is completed.

to replace the feature with its name (or zone number) found on the sector's Star Systems And Zones Sheet. 37 [NPC] has family and friends located at a terraforming base on a small moon in the [SYSTEM] system. Recently a disaster occurred at the base and the complex has been destroyed. They now need rescuing. REFUGEES (SM): [NPC] wants you to pick up 1d6 x 10 refugees (passengers) in zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system and transport them for free to the [SYSTEM] system (see operation for details). Expires: [DATE] (1d10+20 DAYS). Add the generated number of refugees to the zone where the mission is located. Then roll for a random star system (this must be a different star system from the one where the passengers are pick up from); this is where you need to drop off the refugees. When you take refugees onboard they are added as passengers on the log sheet. When you drop off passengers bound for the star system the refugees are heading, you may decline the usual passenger fee to instead deduct the same number from the refugee number where the mission is located. A bereaved citizen has developed a deep hatred for the Cyborgs after they attacked and captured a vessel their family was travelling on. The entire family was wiped out during the attack and now they must be punished. THE CYBORGS (SM): In the [SYSTEM] system [NPC] wants you to track down three Cyborg starships and destroy or capture them (see operation for details). Expires: [DATE] (1d3 months). For background information on the Cyborgs, see Mission # 95-96, History of the Cyborgs in the main D100 Space rulebook. Whenever the captain is in a zone in the mission's star system, they may search for a Cyborgs starship by performing the SCANNING test below. If the test is passed successfully the captain has located the zone where one of the Cyborgs starship can be found and you roll 1d10 for its zone. Unless the captain is already in that zone, they must then head there to attack it. The captain must move directly there, and may not perform any other actions on the way. If they do perform an action before reaching the zone, the Cyborg starship may have moved on and the SCANNING test must be repeated. SCANNING - Test: Int -20, +/- CM, +/- DT [S: -1 AP, -1 PL, roll 1d10 for a zone where the Cyborg starship is located] [F: -1d3 AP, -1d3 PL] (Navigators). When the captain is in the zone with a Cyborg starship see the Space Battle event. The captain must destroy or capture all three Cyborg starships to complete the mission and receive the reward.

"I made it out of a new type of metal I have been developing. I call it Biometal, it's self-repairing. Yeah, it heals. It's also immensely strong and can withstand a lot of punishment. I just need someone to test it out!" THE BATTLE SUIT (AM O2 NV): In zone [ZONE #] in the [SYSTEM] system [NPC] wants you to enter and Kill 1d10+30 enemy whilst wearing a Battle Suit (see operation for details). Expires: [DATE] (1d3 months). If the star system you generate for the mission's location has a moon point of interest, then this is the zone where the mission is located. If the system doesn’t have a moon point of interest then you must generate a random zone where the mission will be located (see Random Star Systems and Zones). The captain must wear the Battle Suit whilst performing the mission. Add Battle Suit to each of the captain's six armour slots. Armour you remove in order to wear the Battle Suit can be recorded to a separate sheet of paper and does not need to be recorded in the Large Equipment Pack. The Battle Suit has an armour value of A5 and you may deflect up to 3 points of damage to a damage track instead of the normal 2. Also, each time you shade the  pip on the time track, all Battle Suit armour slots restore 1 pip of damage (remove 1 damage pip from the damage tracks). If any piece of the Battle Suit is destroyed (i.e. it has taken 6 pips of damage) the mission has failed and cannot be attempted again. Note: If you choose to fail this mission, you may not reattempt it again like you can with other away missions. If the mission is successful as well as the reward, the captain is offered a piece of armour made of the biometal: Roll 1d6 for an armour slot, this is the location the armour protects. Record the armour to the log sheet as "Battle [LOC]" and replace [LOC] with the location you rolled (i.e. if you rolled a 6 (legs), the armour would be called "Battle Legs"). Its armour value is A5 and has a credit value/fix cost of 1000c/200c. You should also add the following note at the bottom of the log sheet; especially if you plan on keeping/using the battle armour: "Battle Armour: You can deflect up to 3 points of damage (instead of the normal 2) to armour with the prefix "Battle". In addition, each time you shade a (Rations)  pip on the time track, it restores 1 pip of damage; and each time a day is checked off on the star chart when the captain is not on an away mission, it restores 2 pips of damage."
